speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the house is dark. Item, there is no bill on the door. Item, Easter Monday is seven days from this morning, and seven is a date.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven days. We rehearse the comedy. I am not opening a house to an empty yard.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Seven is a long fast if a man wants a laugh. You have given me very little to do with my hat this week, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have the hat you had on Saturday. I am not writing you a new one before dinner.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And you are not bringing me another version. The slip is on. One book. I will paste nothing this morning.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam, the song. Sing it on the breath, not on the word.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: On the breath. I can sing it. My throat is clear.

speaker: will_kemp
text: That is a boy's note, not a laugh. I cannot wear it. You might have left me a jig, since the yard is ours and the door is shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The door stays shut. The cuckoo is Sam's. You are not owed a jig for a dark week.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: The hooks are split again. Two of them. I can get into the bodice, and I cannot trust it if I bow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not bow the whole of the way. I am not calling for a hem. The jokes stay where I pencilled them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, no needle this morning. Item, the boy is clear. Item, we are not summoned. Easter Monday is a date, not a mood.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot still says enter where it said. I have not moved a hook, and I have not moved a word. If the bodice fails, it fails in my sight, not in a play we are not giving.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Shall I sing it again? I have the word.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Once more, and then you are done. On the breath.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Cuckoo. That is the whole of it. I am not hoarse.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Not hoarse, and not funny. You are a hard man to a clown in a dark week, Will. I shall survive you. I would like that written down, and I know you will not write it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not write it. The book is one book. Nature has already been told.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: If I turn quick, the left hook talks. I can hear it. I will turn slower, and I will not ask Edith before you say.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Do not ask her. A seamstress in a dark week is a cost with no house to wear it. Slower is free.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Slower, and the same book. I will not hear a new line from a hook.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Enough, Sam. Clear is enough. Go and stand quiet.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Quiet, then. I can be quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seven days. The cue is the one we pasted. Navarre is the king on this stage. I am not writing you a second part this morning.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then keep him. Give me a laugh on the twenty-first, or give me the hat. I am not begging on a Monday.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The twenty-first is the date. Today is rehearsal. Item, we stop while the door is still dull. Go home before a bright idea becomes a second paste.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No second paste. I am gone. The yard can keep the dark.
